build_generic_actor: build a GenericActor with an ActorCore, PRNG key, variable client, and optional adder for JAX-based RL
create_select_action: create a policy action selection call using GenericActor.select_action with an observation input
test_observe_first: test the GenericActor.observe_first method to initialize state and add the first timestep to replay
refactor_observe: refactor the GenericActor.observe method to log actions and next timesteps with extras to the adder
review_update: review the GenericActor.update method to synchronize variable client parameters between learner and actor
